source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project (IFAD-funded) - "Climate Resilient Banana Growing Technique" (ផលិតកម្មដំណាំចេកដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ), November 2018
text: Beyond drip irrigation for supplying water (see the irrigation entry), the booklet stresses the need for a planned drainage layout - channels between rows that carry excess water away from the root zone after heavy rain events, which are expected to become less predictable under climate variability. Maintaining these channels clear of blockage is listed as an ongoing task through the growing season, not a one-time setup step.
